Title: General availability: Azure SQL updates for mid-February 2024

Body.Content:
In mid-February 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Automatically scale compute and grow to extreme scale with high availability using serverless for Hyperscale in Azure SQL Database.
